Usage: headroom accounts [<command>] [flags]
   or: headroom accounts [flags]

The account board, and adding, removing and sharing accounts.

Bare, the account board (see headroom board --help). Its subcommands change the set of
accounts: add seeds a new account's dir, remove deletes one, reserve keeps one for certain
repositories, ledger shares the request budget with a second home on this machine.

Flags:
      --vendor=VENDOR    The vendor whose accounts these are: the board shows only its; add and
                         remove act on it, Claude Code when absent (one of: claude, codex).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --version          Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                         exit.

Arguments and flags of board, the default command:
      --compact          One row per account: each limit's percent and time to reset, every warning
                         at the end of the row.
      --json             Print the board as a JSON document after one refresh round.

Constraints:
  At most one of --compact, --json.

Commands:
  board                               The account board (default).
  add <email>                         Seed the dir for a new subscription.
  remove [<account>]                  Remove an extra account: its Keychain item and its dir.
  reserve [<account>] [<dirs> ...]    Keep an account for certain repositories, and list what is
                                      kept.
  ledger [<root>]                     Spend against another home's ledger, and list the homes that
                                      share it.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why

Run "headroom accounts <command> --help" for a command's details.
